## What's Changed
* skip running unsafe pr check if input is default by @aiqiaoy in https://github.com/actions/checkout/pull/2518
* trim only ascii whitespace for branch by @aiqiaoy in https://github.com/actions/checkout/pull/2521
* escape values passed to --unset by @aiqiaoy in https://github.com/actions/checkout/pull/2530
* Various dependency updates 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/actions/checkout/compare/v7...v7.0.1

## What's Changed

### Enhancements
* Add `mirror` and `mirror-token` inputs for custom Python distribution sources by @luhenry in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1302
* Improve error message clarity by @v-lmvysakh in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1351

### Dependency Upgrade
* Upgrade browserslist from 4.28.2 to 4.28.9 by @dependabot in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1353
* Upgrade @typescript-eslint/parser from 8.62.0 to 8.70.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1343
* Upgrade eslint-plugin-jest from 29.15.2 to 29.16.6 by @dependabot in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1342
* Upgrade @vercel/ncc from 0.44.0 to 0.45.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1357
* Upgrade @types/semver from 7.7.1 to 7.8.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1359
* Upgrade undici from 6.28.0 to 6.29.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1364
* Upgrade ts-jest from 29.4.11 to 29.4.14 by @dependabot in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1361
* Upgrade brace-expansion from 5.0.9 to 5.0.12 by @dependabot in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1365
* Upgrade prettier from 3.8.4 to 3.9.9 and package.json from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1363
* Upgrade @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin from 8.62.0 to 8.71.1 by @dependabot in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1369
* Upgrade actions/checkout from 7.0.0 to 7.0.1 by @dependabot in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1345
* Upgrade cache to 6.3.0 by @v-HarithaVattikuti in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1370
* Resolve Basic Validation audit failures by @v-HarithaVattikuti in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1347
* Resolve npm audit failures by @v-HarithaVattikuti in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1350


## New Contributors
* @luhenry made their first contribution in https://github.com/actions/setup-python/pull/1302

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/actions/setup-python/compare/v7.0.0...v7.1.0
